[[Ritualist Insignia]] }} Advanced training for [[Cantha]]ns. Teaches how to [[interrupt]]. == Quest Information == === Requirements === {{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | active = Any [[insignia quest]] }} * You must have [[Warrior]], [[Ranger]], [[Mesmer]], [[Elementalist]] or [[Ritualist]] as your primary or secondary [[profession]]. === Objectives === * Talk to [[Talon Silverwing]]. * Speak to Talon Silverwing again to begin your test. * Defeat [[Ronsu]]. * Talk to Talon Silverwing again. * See [[Instructor Ng]] for your reward. === Early benefits === Skills provided: * {{w}} {{skill icon|Distracting Blow}} * {{r}} {{skill icon|Distracting Shot}} * {{me}} {{skill icon|Power Spike}} * {{e}} {{skill icon|Gale}} * {{rt}} {{skill icon|Dissonance}} === Reward === * 500 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] == Walkthrough == You will have been provided with skill that allows you to prevent an enemy from activating skills. Use this skill against key enemy skills, and it's an easy match. == NPCs == * {{W}} 12 (20) [[Talon Silverwing]] * {{E}} 10 (20) [[Ronsu]] == Dialogue == === Initial dialogue === ;Instructor Ng :''Your next lesson is in the art of disruption; that is, the art of interrupting your foe's spellcasting. If you can prevent your foe from casting powerful spells on you and your allies, you have a much greater chance of victory in battle. Are you ready to enter the dojo and complete the course in disruption?'' :''By accepting this quest you will abandon other advanced training quests and put yourself into a separate training arena from the rest of your party, if applicable.'' {{Offer dialog | accept = I am ready. | decline = I am not ready yet. | ask = Don't neglect the art of disruption, for you will find this tactic to be quite valuable. }} === Intermediate dialogue === ;Talon Silverwing ''Alright human, it is time to train you in Disruption. You will engage Instructor Ronsu in combat. He will challenge you with potent Elementalist magics, but you have been assigned skills that will help you to overcome him. May Balthazars blessings be upon you.'' ;Talon Silverwing ''Ready...begin!'' ;Talon Silverwing ''You have performed better than I expected. You may return to Instructor Ng and continue your studies.'' === Reward dialogue === ;Instructor Ng ''Well done. You have passed the course in disruption. This training is extremely useful in battle, especially against spells that take longer to cast.'' ==Notes== * Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
